bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited. HALF-YEARLY filing -- balance sheet is the 30-June-2023 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2022 (audited). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2023 (the statement's own 'Ol Jan 2023 to 30 June 2023' column); H1 PAT (321,490,373) and EPS (0.39) match EXACTLY the H1-2023 comparative column independently printed in this bank's own 2024_Q2.json filing. Unlike the FY2024 quarters (see 2024_Q2.json/2024_Q3.json), this H1-cumulative figure cross-validates almost exactly against 2023_Q1.json: H1 PAT (321,490,373) minus Q1 PAT (131,772,992) = 189,717,381, vs this report's own discrete Q2 column of 189,717,411 (a Tk.30 rounding difference only) -- FY2023's quarterly filings are internally consistent with each other, unlike FY2024's. Paid-up capital rose from Tk.8,160.31m (31-Mar-2023, per 2023_Q1.json) to Tk.8,241.92m (30-Jun-2023) -- a bonus share issue between Q1 and Q2 2023, consistent with this bank's well-documented recurring bonus-share pattern (see sources.json). Asset quality remained modest and stable: classified loans (Note 8.11, Solo) Tk.4,090.08m (NPL 4.96%), essentially flat versus 31-Dec-2022 (Tk.4,031.22m) and 31-Mar-2023 (Tk.4,170.33m, per 2023_Q1.json) -- if anything a slight improvement in the NPL ratio (5.27% to 4.96%) as the loan book grew faster than classified loans. The loans-and-advances-only provision shortfall (Note 8.10) stayed flat: Tk.369.90m (30-Jun-2023) versus Tk.370.00m at both 31-Mar-2023 and 31-Dec-2022, referencing the same DOS (CAMS)1157/41(dividend)/2023-2113 letter (25 April 2023) already found in 2023_Q1.json. Capital adequacy (CRAR/RWA/Tier1/Tier2) disclosures are not part of this quarterly unaudited financial statement.
